video_title: 'I was bad tonight' - Victor Wembanyama & the Spurs react to Game 1 loss to the Knicks | NBA on ESPN

quotes.speaker: Mitch
quotes.summary_phrase: Spurs coach on Wembanyama's slow start and need for interior pressure
quotes.excerpt: we need to get him moving in space and towards the rim
quotes.quote: He missed a few shots early and we need to get him moving in space and towards the rim, whether that's on rolls or running in transition, but we need the pressure on the rim and the force in the paint.

quotes.speaker: Mitch
quotes.summary_phrase: Spurs coach on the team's need for better shot selection and interior play
quotes.excerpt: we definitely didn't have enough pressure on the paint all night
quotes.quote: We definitely didn't have enough pressure on the paint all night, whether that was in transition or in the half court. We have to make sure we're still putting force in the paint, and we'll still get our threes up with that, but we can't work outside-in. We have to go more inside-out.

quotes.speaker: Mitch
quotes.summary_phrase: Spurs coach on defensive breakdowns and second-chance points allowed to the Knicks
quotes.excerpt: the offensive rebounds crushed us, 23 second-chance points
quotes.quote: It felt like some of that was bad offense on our part, and then some of that was not being able to square the basketball up and give the proper resistance. And then the offensive rebounds crushed us, 23 second-chance points. We're up one, 93-94, 94-95, get them to miss, they get a rebound, Brunson hits a three, they go on an 11-0 run. Makes it tough.

quotes.speaker: Mitch
quotes.summary_phrase: Spurs coach on Jalen Brunson's skilled performance and shot-making
quotes.excerpt: he's a tremendous player that's skilled, picks his spots, knows his angles
quotes.quote: He's a tremendous player that's skilled, picks his spots, knows his angles, shoots contested shots without being sped up. He's a phenomenal player and we've got to keep making him work. 30 points on 31 shots is something that you probably want to keep making him work for those points.

quotes.speaker: Mitch
quotes.summary_phrase: Spurs coach on defensive breakdowns and the need for better offensive discipline
quotes.excerpt: there was a combination of a few times defensive breakdowns with their communication or rotations
quotes.quote: There was a combination of a few times defensive breakdowns with their communication or rotations. There was a few times it felt like we didn't have an appropriate offensive possession in terms of trying to be greedy for our best shot and using spacing and passing, because that's how we play.

quotes.speaker: Victor Wembanyama
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama on Jalen Brunson's elite status and the series ahead
quotes.excerpt: he's an elite player and we got the chance that we're going to have many more chances
quotes.quote: He's an elite player and we got the chance that we're going to have many more chances. It's a first-to-four series, so we're going to have time to work on it.

quotes.speaker: Victor Wembanyama
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama on his poor performance and the need to adjust
quotes.excerpt: I was bad tonight. It's not more complicated than that
quotes.quote: I agree with the coach. I was bad tonight. It's not more complicated than that. I'm going to figure it out. It's not more complicated than that. I was bad tonight.

quotes.speaker: Victor Wembanyama
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama on his recovery protocol and accountability
quotes.excerpt: protocol is big for me. Doing everything right, doing all the film I need to do
quotes.quote: Protocol is big for me. And by protocol I mean doing everything right, doing all the film I need to do, doing all the recovery, speaking to my team, figuring out the things and holding each other accountable. That's for me doesn't get more complicated than that. I'm not an overthinker.

quotes.speaker: Victor Wembanyama
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama on the team's late-game collapse and offensive rebounds
quotes.excerpt: we let them get an offensive rebound, so that's on us
quotes.quote: We let them get an offensive rebound, so that's on us. And after that, that's an experienced team, they know how to play with momentum, and we had the momentum until late in that game. This is why I said we let that one go.

quotes.speaker: Victor Wembanyama
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama on his mindset and avoiding self-blame
quotes.excerpt: it's almost not like I have anything to figure out. It's almost like I have to play normal
quotes.quote: It's almost not like I have anything to figure out. It's almost like I have to play normal, not even good. I just get I just it's like I just doing the right things is enough. It's when we play bad, when I play bad, it's when we shoot ourselves in the foot. This is why I'm not worried. It's we're going to be so much better, I'm going to be so much better.

quotes.speaker: Dylan
quotes.summary_phrase: Dylan on Jalen Brunson's skill and the Spurs' defensive focus
quotes.excerpt: he's a great guard, all-star guard. He's going to get to his spots regardless
quotes.quote: He's a great guard, all-star guard. He's going to get to his spots regardless. I mean, it's just kind of how he picks his angles and just gets to his spots. I mean, he probably does it beyond the best, but for us, it's kind of just doubling down on our game plan and what we just always stuck to, which is defense.

quotes.speaker: Dylan
quotes.summary_phrase: Dylan on the team's long-term focus and consistency
quotes.excerpt: for us it's just more about playing the long game and just kind of being consistent
quotes.quote: For us it's just more about playing the long game and just kind of being consistent on our habits. And I think that's the biggest part and I feel like if we just stay consistent, then everything's going to work out.

quotes.speaker: Dylan
quotes.summary_phrase: Dylan on team fatigue and the Knicks' execution
quotes.excerpt: I feel like both teams was fatigued really. I feel like they kind of just executed
quotes.quote: I feel like both teams was fatigued really. I feel like they kind of just executed a little better and I feel like they they just execute on their plays and at the end of the game they kind of just I just said execute, but I feel like it was a it was more of a track meet today.

quotes.speaker: Dylan
quotes.summary_phrase: Dylan on the need for accountability and staying positive
quotes.excerpt: there's a lot of controllables on our end that I feel like we didn't hold ourselves to
quotes.quote: There's a lot of controllables on our end that I feel like we didn't hold ourselves to the high standard and I feel like we let a lot of those slip away from us. So I we're going to be better, we're going to bounce back and we just got to keep staying positive.

quotes.speaker: Dylan
quotes.excerpt: I just got to keep on staying aggressive. I got to keep on just keep my foot
quotes.quote: I just got to keep on staying aggressive. I got to keep on just keep my foot on the gas. But I feel like it was a it was kind of the same thing but I feel like they kind of some shots didn't go in for us, some shots went in for them.

quotes.speaker: Dylan
quotes.summary_phrase: Dylan on Victor Wembanyama's confidence and the team's resilience
quotes.excerpt: he never backs down for a moment. He kind of always steps up and meets it
quotes.quote: I mean I think we're all confident. I feel like that's kind of who he is. He never backs down for a moment. He kind of always steps up and meets it. But we're also confident but we also I mean got we have a chip on our shoulder from this game we just lost.
